input.original_instruction: For your start point you are facing a wooden garden arbor turn around so that you can see the rows of white chairs to your right and left. And move forward through the center aisle. Once you are at the end of the aisle  you will need to make a right turn towards the column that's to the right. And from that column that is supporting the balcony above you will see a bench, a black iron bench. You will need to make your way to the second black iron bench that is directly opposite and hop over the bench. you will see there's an open doorway. Move forward to the left and enter that doorway. And move one step inside it looks like a dining room or a banquet hall. Turn to the left you will move in front of a column and you will also see there's a banquet table to your left and one to the right closet to the flat screen TV on the wall. You will need to move in between both tables.

decision.rationale: The source supports distinct completed navigation objectives. Boundaries are placed only where the preceding objective has a supported outcome and the next stage can continue from that state.

subtasks: For your start point, you are facing a wooden garden arbor. Turn around so that you can see the rows of white chairs to your right and left. Move forward through the center aisle. Make your way to the second black iron bench directly opposite and hop over the bench. You will see an open doorway.

Move forward to the left and enter that doorway. Move one step inside; it looks like a dining room or a banquet hall. Turn to the left. You will move in front of a column and see a banquet table to your left and one to your right, closest to the flat-screen TV on the wall. Move in between both tables.
